mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the past 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 5.0%, the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% MoM signal weakening consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% MoM, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% MoM signals economic deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases over the past 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index base 2017=100), it indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 3.0% signal aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong growth regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% MoM signals consumer spending weakness, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS declines > 0.5% MoM and GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
